name: Beijing Caishikou Department Store Co.,Ltd.
summary: Beijing Caishikou Department Store Co.,Ltd. operates as a leading retailer primarily focused on precious metal and gemstone products. The company's diverse inventory features a wide array of gold jewelry, alongside gold and silver commemorative coin medals, platinum articles, and various precious stones like diamonds, rubies, sapphires, and emeralds. They also offer K gold pieces and engage in the sale of gold investment and cultural products. Products are distributed through their network of directly managed chain stores as well as through online sales channels. Established in 1956, the firm's headquarters are located in Beijing, China.
